capabilities: Create scene cards with header, action, emotional shift and conflict fields
Drag cards to swap, insert or batch-move them between acts and columns
Rename, add, remove, reorder and collapse acts with 1-4 columns each
Export action-line summaries and run a self-check for missing fields
Write all board data back to the note as plain Markdown
disambiguation: Not a prose-writing or grammar tool; it is a scene-card outlining board that writes plain Markdown into notes.
extras: No network access, telemetry or analytics; some UI strings, commands and beat names are in Chinese.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in scene-card board for outlining stories that keeps everything in plain Markdown.
summary: Card-based story outlining board where each card is a scene with header, action, emotional shift and conflict, stored as plain Markdown.
